VALUE In Progress N/A DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Urban Planning & Design Project Overview This project covers urban planning, landscape and architectural design for a major rural development initiative. BECT's scope includes conceptual and detailed design, tender documents, site supervision and project management, supporting land reclamation, agricultural productivity and stronger local capacity in rural land management. BECT's scope included project management and site supervision. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design and urban planning & design.
